adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, explicitly bypassing the normal cooking/rendering pipeline (which is where sanitization typically occurs). `TopicEmbed.import` and `import_remote` create posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` using HTML content sourced from RSS/remote (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)` and `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)`), and `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` renders it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. The added spec (`spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`) even asserts `post.cooked == post.raw`, confirming unsanitized HTML is expected and there is no test asserting sanitization against script/event-handler injection. This is a verifiable XSS risk introduced by the diff.
